description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.0025 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Base or Ethereum transaction hash -> plain JSON: status (success/failed/pending), block time, confirmations, from/to, ETH value, gas used and fee (incl. Base L1 fee), method selector + name, and every ERC-20/ERC-721 Transfer in the receipt with token symbol, decimals and human amounts. Optional payment check: expect_to + expect_token (USDC, ETH, symbol or address) + expect_amount confirms a payment arrived (e.g. verify a USDC or x402 settlement). Public RPC data only. When to use: Use tx-explain to understand one transaction or to verify a payment (USDC, ETH, any ERC-20) before delivering goods. Use wallet-profile for an address, contract-abi for a contract interface and token-risk to judge a token.

expect_amount.description: optional: minimum amount in human units, e.g. 0.001

expect_to.description: optional: recipient address the payment should reach

expect_token.description: optional: ETH, USDC, USDT, EURC, DAI, WETH ... or a token address (default USDC)

name: tx_explain
title: Transaction Explainer + Payment Check
